comments: Input facts: ego is a car responder, agent1 is a pedestrian initiator, and agentStatic is a car responder; the forward moving ego interacts with a pedestrian in the trafficway moving around, entering, exiting, or interacting with an adjacent vehicle/object. Chosen assumptions: agentStatic is stopped in the adjacent right lane. Initiator agent1 exits the vicinity of its left rear side and walks into the ego travel lane. Ego remains forward moving until proximity to the pedestrian triggers sustained braking; the stopped vehicle remains stationary as a responder. Speeds: ego 4–6 m/s, pedestrian 1.1–1.4 m/s; vehicle longitudinal separation 16–20 m; pedestrian response threshold 8–10 m. Conflict opportunity, without requiring collision.
